spec_coverage.notes: Fresh independent re-verification of the entire frontend. Every assigned requirement is implemented and behaviorally correct; every change traces to SPEC/DECISIONS/plan/adjudicated ruling. Zero findings. Key verifications: (1) §8.1 hook matches the spec code block exactly (interfaces, query key, enabled guard, mutation invalidation); no fabricated `|| []`/`|| 0`/`|| ""`/`??` in any new file (grep-verified). (2) §8.2 precedence is correct in JobCriteriaSection.tsx:44-85 — isLoading first, isError next (conventions fix #4), then in-flight, then failed+zeroCriteriaFailure (row 2), then failed-other (row 3), then criteria (row 4), then null (row 5); failed-latest EmptyStates correctly beat an older succeeded card (adjudicated flag 5). Button label is Generate-only in neverExtracted else Regenerate (line 85), covering the state-1-over-state-5 case. Action rows render OUTSIDE EmptyState; EmptyState receives only icon/title/message with no roomy/borderless. (3) The section Regenerate button carries BOTH loading={isInFlight} and disabled={isInFlight} (lines 160-161). Although plan F.2.1.6 lists only loading, the disabled prop is an ADJUDICATED REQUIRED fix from impl Phase 6 round-1 F1 [HIGH] (ORCHESTRATION-LOG line 32) plus the Phase 7 rule-11 hard sub-rule ('loading requires disabled'); confirmed via Button/index.js that `loading` alone does NOT block clicks (handleClick only guards on `disabled`), so `disabled` is a genuine and required double-open guard — correct, not a deviation. (4) Confirm modal owns its mutation with loading+disabled on the primary (rule 11) — RegenerateJobCriteriaConfirmModal.tsx:21,68-69. (5) Both MODIFIED frontend files (WebsocketGlobalChannelHandler.tsx, aiSummaryWebsocketPayloads.ts) contain ONLY the spec-required additions — no scope creep. JobSetupAiSettings.tsx diff is purely additive; all pre-existing behavior untouched; hook+ModalContext moved into JobCriteriaSection per adjudicated extraction (plan D-1). (6) Copy rules clean: zero em/en dashes (grep-verified), zero 'read' vocabulary (grep-verified), sentence case, static button labels, timestamp only in card desc. (7) All Decided-OUT items absent; no job-status checks anywhere in the UI. The adjudicated history prop was NOT flagged per instruction.
